lark_bind.needs_auth_description: Sign in to Multica to complete the binding. The token in the link binds your Lark account to this Multica user, so you must be logged in first.
lark_bind.done_description: Your next message to the Bot in Lark will go straight to the Agent. You can close this tab.
lark_bind.error_admin_hint: If this keeps happening, ask the workspace admin to re-send the binding link from Lark.
lark_bind.error_missing_token: The link is missing its binding token. Ask the Bot to send a new one in Lark.
lark_bind.error_expired: This binding link is invalid or expired (links are valid for 15 minutes). Ask the Bot to send a new one.
lark_bind.error_already_bound: This Lark account is already bound to a different Multica user. Account transfers must go through an explicit unbind first.
lark_bind.error_not_member: You're signed in to a Multica account that isn't a member of this workspace.
lark_bind.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and if the problem persists, contact the workspace admin.

dws_auth.title: Connect DingTalk
dws_auth.description: DWS is not signed in or its session has expired. Authorize DingTalk to continue processing pending messages.
dws_auth.identity_mismatch: DWS is signed in, but its account does not match the DingTalk account signed in to Multica. Switch to the correct account to continue.
dws_auth.not_installed: DWS CLI was not found. Install DWS and make sure the dws command is available on PATH, then try again.
dws_auth.browser_hint: Your browser will open. Complete the DingTalk authorization there, then return to Multica.
dws_auth.resuming: DingTalk connected through DWS. Resuming pending direct messages.
dws_auth.invalid_client_credentials: The DingTalk application credentials used by DWS are invalid or expired. Check DWS_CLIENT_ID, DWS_CLIENT_SECRET, or the local DWS application configuration, then authorize again.
dws_auth.auth_check_failed: DWS sign-in status is temporarily unavailable. The message is queued and will retry automatically.
dws_auth.identity_check_failed: The DWS account could not be verified. The message is queued and will retry automatically.
dws_auth.recipient_identity_unresolved: The DingTalk recipient could not be resolved. The message is queued and will retry automatically.
dws_auth.send_failed: The DingTalk direct message could not be sent. It remains queued and will retry automatically.
dws_auth.delivery_tracking_failed: The DingTalk direct message entered the send flow, but delivery cannot be confirmed yet. It will retry automatically.
dws_auth.delivery_failed: DingTalk reported that direct-message delivery failed. The message remains queued and will retry automatically.
